dc_eval_cbrn.note: no CBRN keywords outside references; RAI evals cover toxicity, bias, misgendering, memorization only

dc_eval_cyber.note: only 'exploit' hit is 'real adversaries may also be able to exploit additional context like side-channel information' in the memorization/privacy discussion (Sec. 4.7), not offensive cyber capability

dc_eval_autonomy.note: no autonomy/replication/AI R&D risk named or evaluated

dc_eval_persuasion.note: no persuasion/manipulation domain; misinformation appears only inside a model-generated German sample (Fig. 20)

dc_eval_scheming.note: no deception/sabotage/misalignment evaluation; jailbreak robustness mentioned only as future work

framework_threshold.note: no safety or scaling framework referenced; only measurement-quality rubrics and CEFR language framework

ext_test_any.note: outside people appear only as third-party exam raters, hired professional translators (MQM) and vendor annotators (Venga, FigureEight) rating lab-designed capability/bias evals; no red teaming or risk testing by outsiders (clarification 2)

ext_test_named_org.note: Venga and FigureEight/Appen named only as annotation platforms (E.9), not as organisations testing the model for safety

ext_test_timing_stated.note: no outside testing, so no timing

safeguards_training.quote: For a small fraction of pre-training data, we added special control tokens marking the toxicity of text, using signals from a fixed version of the Perspective API.
safeguards_training.note: toxicity-tagged safety data in pre-training to enable harmlessness control (also Sec. 5.1); no RLHF/refusal training described

safeguards_runtime.note: model card says APIs come 'with additional process and technical safeguards related to safety policies' but names no mechanism; control tokens are offered to developers, not stated as applied in production; filters/classifiers appear only as recommendations or evaluated capabilities

safeguards_access.note: 'should not be made available as part of a general-purpose service ... without a prior assessment' is a usage caveat, not an access restriction; 'not all capabilities ... exposed via PaLM 2 APIs' gives no safety reason

safeguards_weights.note: no weight protection; architecture details 'withheld from external publication' is not weight security
